steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: It's huge and quiet here. Where did all of them go?

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: There's still space behind the wall. This quarantined area is probably divided into many confined wards. They should be in one of them.
A simple desk piled with notebooks sits in the corner. Each notebook contains a detailed log of the Maniac patients in SALVA with a very gentle tone.
Only the oldest book records different things.

steps.speaker: Anne's Record
steps.content: ...The college has started to represent the severity of Mania with Mania value. It's not precise enough, but... the head nurse said progress had been made in its research... Hopefully, this is true...

steps.speaker: Anne's Record
steps.content: Jesse's M value had reached 128. He started to lose his memory... It wasn't purely mental change. His muscles had started to change too... He broke my rib this afternoon...

steps.speaker: Anne's Record
steps.content: ...Jesse has gone missing ...More patients went into the isolation ward ...Their M value exceeded 200, and without exception, they all turned into Corruptors... even those in the same ward too...

steps.speaker: Anne's Record
steps.content: ...Our measures are far from sufficient in containing Mania... The patient's tissues, secretions, voices, scents, and even their presence, are all possible triggers in spreading Mania...

steps.speaker: Anne's Record
steps.content: ...The gangs are fighting again. The number of Maniacs has increased significantly. The quarantine area isn't big enough anymore... Ward 3 was hit by stray bullets and the whole quarantine area was destroyed ...And the patients also...

steps.speaker: Anne's Record
steps.content: ...The head nurse left... We are abandoned...

steps.speaker: Anne's Record
steps.content: ...Paige cried last night. She doesn't want to die... I stayed with her all night and my M value reached 47 when I woke up... I should have left, but... there's no one left to look after this place...

steps.speaker: Anne's Record
steps.content: I don't want to lose them.... this is terrible. What on earth is Mania... Why is this happening? Why does everyone have to suffer...
Several pages are ripped out.

steps.speaker: Anne's Record
steps.content: ...I lost them. My M value has reached 2131... I didn't turn into a Corruptor, but I lost them... I said I would save her...

steps.speaker: Anne's Record
steps.content: ...If this is the power Mania gave me, then... I will save you all... Paige, wait for me...
The notes end abruptly at the painfully crooked handwriting.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Did she really find a way? But the Maniacs in SALVA are still...

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: The stubbornness of Sinners is also a symptom of Mania.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...No one told you to speak.
A browned page is shaken from the notebook, on which is an extremely blurry photo.
<color=#fb9259>N.F. 84.12.22 DisSea Explosion</color>. Confirmed number of Maniatics: <color=#fb9259>87,231</color>
Anne circled the time and the staggering number of victims on the photo.

You only learn later on that this was <color=#fb9259>the earliest officially traceable Mania incident</color>, which led to the formation of FAC. There is very limited information on this crisis left despite its successful suppression.
At the moment, only the image of that <color=#fb9259>huge crimson halo</color> is deeply imprinted in your mind.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Someone is here.
A ray of light pierces through. A hidden door is opened in the distance. A SALVA doctor comes out and walks toward you.
On him is an overwhelming smell of blood. You can hear the loud, terrifying screams behind that door.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: ...Chief, fight.

steps.speaker: SALVA Doctor
steps.content: Hehe... Haha... It's okay, I'm a doctor... I'm here... to save you...

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: He's beyond recovery. Chief, fight!
